dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: ご相談をはじめる前に、性別と年齢、あと何とお呼びすればいいか教えていただけますか？あだ名でも大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Before we begin our session, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you would like me to call you? A nickname is fine too.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 29歳男です
dialogue.English: I'm a 29-year-old man.

dialogue.content: 渡辺とお呼びください
dialogue.English: Please call me Watanabe.

dialogue.content: 渡辺さんですね、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Mr. Watanabe, got it. Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでは、本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Alright then, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 毎日割と楽しく過ごしていますが
dialogue.English: I generally enjoy my days, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: たまに無気力になる日があります
dialogue.English: There are days when I feel unmotivated.

dialogue.content: そのときにどうすればいいか教えていただきたいです
dialogue.English: I'd like to know what I can do when that happens.

dialogue.content: なるほど、わかりました
dialogue.English: I see, I understand.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: たまに無気力になるきっかけのようなものは何か心当たりはありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any idea what might be triggering these occasional feelings of being unmotivated?

dialogue.content: 特に心当たりがないんです
dialogue.English: I can't really think of anything specific.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはもやもやしますね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be frustrating.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、つい最近無気力になったのはいつですか？
dialogue.English: Then, when was the most recent time you felt unmotivated?

dialogue.content: ここ1年間くらいですね
dialogue.English: It's been happening for about the last year.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…1年も…すっきりしたいですよね
dialogue.English: I see... for a whole year... You must want to find some clarity.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 無気力になったとき、どのようなことを考えていますか？
dialogue.English: When you feel unmotivated, what kinds of thoughts go through your mind?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Let's see...

dialogue.content: ボーっとしてしまいます
dialogue.English: I just zone out.

dialogue.content: あとは手につかない
dialogue.English: And I can't seem to get anything done.

dialogue.content: 感じです
dialogue.English: That's what it's like.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それはどんどんつらくなってくるでしょうね…
dialogue.English: I see, that must get progressively more difficult...

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ボーっとしているときはどこにいるときが多いですか？
dialogue.English: Where are you most often when you're zoning out?

dialogue.content: 自宅ですね
dialogue.English: At home.

dialogue.content: 仕事は在宅勤務です
dialogue.English: I work from home.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 以前は職場でお仕事されていたんですか？
dialogue.English: Did you used to work at an office before?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, I did.

dialogue.content: コロナ禍で在宅勤務になったという感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you started working from home because of the pandemic?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど…コロナ…不安を感じますよね…
dialogue.English: I see... COVID... it does bring a lot of anxiety, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: It does.

dialogue.content: 職場でお仕事をされていたときは、無気力を感じていましたか？
dialogue.English: When you were working at the office, did you feel unmotivated then as well?

dialogue.content: 少しあった気がします
dialogue.English: I think I felt it a little.

dialogue.content: 今ほど気になるほどではなかったですが
dialogue.English: But not enough to bother me like it does now.

dialogue.content: なるほど…おつらい中お仕事されていたんですね…
dialogue.English: I see... It must have been difficult working while feeling that way...

dialogue.content: モヤモヤします
dialogue.English: It's unsettling.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…はやくすっきりしたいですね
dialogue.English: I understand... I'm sure you want to resolve this soon.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自宅でお仕事されているときは、もやもやは感じますか？
dialogue.English: When you're working from home, do you feel that unsettling feeling?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 感じます
dialogue.English: I do.

dialogue.content: 今特に不安を感じることは何かありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything in particular that you feel anxious about right now?

dialogue.content: 充実を感じることが一番なので
dialogue.English: Feeling a sense of fulfillment is the most important thing to me.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 足枷になっている
dialogue.English: And this is holding me back.

dialogue.content: と思います
dialogue.English: I think.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは居たたまれなくなってきますよね…
dialogue.English: I see, that must make you feel quite restless...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お仕事において、渡辺さんが一番充実感を感じるのはどんなときですか？
dialogue.English: In your work, when do you feel the greatest sense of fulfillment, Mr. Watanabe?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Let's see...

dialogue.content: 誰かの役に立てたと思えたとき
dialogue.English: When I feel like I've been able to help someone.

dialogue.content: ですね
dialogue.English: That's when.

dialogue.content: 素敵ですね！
dialogue.English: That's wonderful!

dialogue.content: お客様にもさぞ喜んでいただけるんでしょうね
dialogue.English: Your customers must be very pleased with you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ちなみにお仕事は何をされているか、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, could you tell me what kind of work you do?

dialogue.content: 可能な範囲で大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Only as much as you're comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: 営業職です
dialogue.English: I'm in sales.

dialogue.content: わかりました、ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: I see, thank you!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 営業職となると、コロナ禍で外に出にくくなった現状では、充実感を感じにくい状況ですね…
dialogue.English: Being in sales, with the current situation where it's hard to go out because of the pandemic, it must be difficult to feel that sense of fulfillment...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 直接顔を見て話せないですね
dialogue.English: I can't talk to people face-to-face.

dialogue.content: そうですね、お客様の顔が見えないとなんだか寂しいですね
dialogue.English: I agree, it must feel a bit lonely when you can't see your customers' faces.

dialogue.content: そう思います
dialogue.English: I think so too.

dialogue.content: 現状では、お客様とはどのようにコンタクトを取っているんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In the current situation, how do you get in contact with your customers?

dialogue.content: 電話で応対しています
dialogue.English: I handle things over the phone.

dialogue.content: なるほど、お声だけでお話されているんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're communicating just by voice.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お客様のお役に立てたと思うときは、どんなときですか？
dialogue.English: When do you feel you've been helpful to your clients?

dialogue.content: ありがとうと言われたら嬉しいです
dialogue.English: It makes me happy when they say 'thank you'.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、こちらも嬉しくなりますものね
dialogue.English: Of course, that makes you happy too, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 渡辺さんは、どのような想いでお仕事をされているか、改めてお聞かせいただいていいですか？
dialogue.English: Mr. Watanabe, could you tell me again what your mindset is when you approach your work?

dialogue.content: 喜んでもらえるために、自分ができることをしよう
dialogue.English: "Let's do what I can to make people happy."

dialogue.content: と思ってます
dialogue.English: That's what I think.

dialogue.content: とても素敵です
dialogue.English: That's very admirable.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 私もなんだか嬉しくなりました
dialogue.English: Hearing that makes me feel happy too, somehow.

dialogue.content: そう言って頂けて嬉しいです
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: それでは、
dialogue.English: Well then,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 在宅勤務になって、お客様に喜んでいただく最大の足枷は何とお考えですか？
dialogue.English: Since you started working from home, what do you think is the biggest obstacle to making your customers happy?

dialogue.content: 無気力に邪魔されることだと思うので
dialogue.English: I think it's being hindered by my lack of motivation,

dialogue.content: それをなんとかしたいです
dialogue.English: so I want to do something about that.

dialogue.content: そうですね、心苦しくなりますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that must weigh heavily on you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までのお話から、一番大きな変化はコロナ禍で、それが無気力に影響していると思うのですが、如何ですか？
dialogue.English: Based on what we've discussed, it seems the biggest change has been the pandemic, and that it might be influencing this lack of motivation. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね…
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's it...

dialogue.content: ぴんと来ない感じなのですね
dialogue.English: So it doesn’t quite click for you.

dialogue.content: 無気力は常に感じるかんじですか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel unmotivated all the time?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…それはずっとおつらかったですよね…
dialogue.English: I see... that must have been very difficult all this time...

dialogue.content: 無気力は週に一度とかですね
dialogue.English: The lack of motivation happens about once a week or so.

dialogue.content: なるほど、週一無気力がくると思うと不安ですよね
dialogue.English: I see, it must be unsettling to think that it's coming once a week.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ボーっとするたびに無気力になる感じですか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel unmotivated each time you zone out?

dialogue.content: 無気力に感じるときにボーっとしてる気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like I zone out when I'm feeling unmotivated.

dialogue.content: なるほど、逆なんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so it’s the other way around.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自宅のどこで無気力になりがちですか？
dialogue.English: Where at home do you tend to feel unmotivated?

dialogue.content: 自分の部屋です
dialogue.English: In my room.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、なるほど
dialogue.English: I see, okay.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのくらいの時間、無気力になっていますか？
dialogue.English: About how long does the unmotivated state last?

dialogue.content: おおよそで大丈夫です
dialogue.English: A rough estimate is fine.

dialogue.content: 2時間です
dialogue.English: About two hours.

dialogue.content: その時間がもったいないというか、無駄に感じます
dialogue.English: I feel like that time is a waste.

dialogue.content: 2時間も…とてもしんどいですよね…もどかしさも感じるのですね
dialogue.English: Two whole hours... that must be very trying... and you feel frustrated by it, too.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 充実とは真逆だと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's the complete opposite of fulfillment.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、今の状態から脱却したいですよね
dialogue.English: I agree, you want to break free from this current state, don't you?

dialogue.content: 睡眠はいかがですか？取れていますか？
dialogue.English: How is your sleep? Are you getting enough?

dialogue.content: 毎日7時間半は寝てます
dialogue.English: I sleep seven and a half hours every day.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それは一安心です
dialogue.English: I see; that’s a relief.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 在宅勤務でも、生活リズムは整えておられるのですね、すごいと思います
dialogue.English: Even while working from home, you’re maintaining a regular daily rhythm. That's impressive.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: すみません、分析の時間を2分を頂いてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Excuse me, may I take a couple of minutes to gather my thoughts?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: （難しいです…！）
dialogue.English: (This is difficult...!)

dialogue.content: （申し訳ないです…）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry...)

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: No, no.

dialogue.content: お気になさらないでください
dialogue.English: Please don’t worry about it.

dialogue.content: 一度今回のお話をまとめたいと思いますがよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to summarize what we've discussed so far, is that okay?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 渡辺さんは、1年ほど前から無気力感を感じるようになりました
dialogue.English: Mr. Watanabe, you started experiencing a lack of motivation about a year ago.

dialogue.content: コロナ禍で在宅勤務になり、自宅にいるときに無気力感を感じる
dialogue.English: You started working from home due to the pandemic, and you feel this lack of motivation when you’re at home.

dialogue.content: 一番不安に感じることは充実感を感じられないことです
dialogue.English: The thing that makes you most anxious is not being able to feel a sense of fulfillment.

dialogue.content: お客様のお役に立てるときが最も充実感を感じる
dialogue.English: You feel most fulfilled when you can be helpful to your customers.

dialogue.content: 無気力感の原因がわからず、悩んでおられます
dialogue.English: You’re troubled because you don’t know the cause of this lack of motivation.

dialogue.content: このような感じだと思うのですがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: I believe that's the gist of it. Does that sound right to you?

dialogue.content: はい、その通りです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 無気力感を抱えながらもお客様のためにお仕事をしておられた
dialogue.English: You have been working for your customers while dealing with this lack of motivation.

dialogue.content: 本当に素敵なことだと思います
dialogue.English: I think that’s truly wonderful.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 使命感や責任感が強い方だと私は感じます
dialogue.English: I get the sense that you are someone with a strong sense of mission and responsibility.

dialogue.content: 渡辺さんが今できることは、どんなことだとお考えですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think are some things you can do right now, Mr. Watanabe?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Let's see...

dialogue.content: 無気力に気づいたときに、
dialogue.English: When I notice I'm unmotivated,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 対策を考えたり
dialogue.English: I could think about countermeasures,

dialogue.content: 対策をこうじること
dialogue.English: and implement them.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ
dialogue.English: Yes, yes.

dialogue.content: でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I suppose?

dialogue.content: 素晴らしいですね…！
dialogue.English: That's a wonderful idea...!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 対策を講じたとき、ご自身ではどのように感じると思いますか？
dialogue.English: When you take those measures, how do you think you'll feel?

dialogue.content: 無気力を恐れることが少なくなる気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like I would be less afraid of the lack of motivation.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね！
dialogue.English: I see!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もしかすると、無気力を感じたときは、対策を講じる～行動する～合図なのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Perhaps when you feel unmotivated, it could be a signal to put measures in place—to take action.

dialogue.content: なるほど！
dialogue.English: I see!

dialogue.content: 無気力を感じた時は、「今できることをする」といいかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: When you feel unmotivated, it might be good to think, "I'll do what I can do right now."

dialogue.content: 分かりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 私からは以上です…お時間を取らせてしまって申し訳ありませんでした
dialogue.English: That's all from me... I'm very sorry for taking up so much of your time.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: No, not at all.

dialogue.content: 相談できてよかったです！
dialogue.English: I'm glad I was able to talk about this!

dialogue.content: そう言っていただけて嬉しいです！
dialogue.English: I'm so happy to hear you say that!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 渡辺さんには無気力を行動力に変える力があると信じています！
dialogue.English: I believe you have the ability to turn a lack of motivation into action, Mr. Watanabe!

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました！では以上でご相談を終了致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much! This concludes our session for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました、失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Thank you, goodbye.
